description: Train your ear: hear two notes played with WebAudio, guess the interval, and track your score and streak.

faqs.a: All 12 intervals from minor 2nd to octave, played as two sequential notes with a real WebAudio synth.
Your best streak is saved in this browser so you can beat it next session.
No — every note is synthesized live with the Web Audio API; nothing is downloaded or uploaded.

howto: Click "New round" — you'll hear two notes.
Click the interval you think you heard.
Your score, streak and best streak update live.
Use "Replay" to hear the notes again.
title: Interval Trainer
